4d69565d5233d4a70475b06a.english: The Vukah Brawler is a boss in Enshrouded. Way larger than a normal Vukah, The Brawler is the champion from gladiators fights, organised by a warrior sect

4d69565d5233d4a70475b06a.reviewNote: Repair singular boss context and untranslated Brawler title.
